attributes.board_name: Louisiana Board of Examiners for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-sponsored activities; communication-disorders programs of ASHA, AAA, LAA, LSHA, SPALS and similar; ASHA-approved CE providers or AAA-approved activities (incl. digital media); related organizations (e.g. CEC, IDA); college courses in the area of licensure (3 semester / 6 quarter hours = 10 h); distance learning; employer workshops/in-services (max 5 h in a related area); peer-reviewed article; presenting (1.5x first time). Self-study needs pre-approval (digital media max 5 h, journal articles max 5 h). College teaching does not count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Graduated scale by month of initial license: Jul–Sep 10 h, Oct–Dec 6 h, Jan–Mar 3 h, Apr–Jun 0 h for that license period.
rules.audit_note: CE activities are recorded on the renewal as prescribed by the Board; a percentage of licensees is randomly audited each year (clock hours, content and attendance). Keep records 3 years; repeated activities within 3 years do not count.
rules.notes: License period July 1 – June 30; all licenses renew annually by June 30. Of the 10 hours, at least 5 must be directly related to the area of licensure; up to 5 may be in related areas (billing, coding, record-keeping, ethics, supervision). Dispensing audiologists: at least 3 of the 10 hours in hearing aid dispensing topics (may opt out if no dispensing during the year). Dual SLP + audiology licensees: 15 hours per year (min 5 audiology, min 5 SLP). June events can count in either period. Inactive status: 5 hours per inactive year (max 25) to resume practice. The rule says 'each licensee', which includes licensed SLP assistants.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LXXV, §125, §127; R.S. 37:2650 et seq.
rules.rule_quote: Each licensee shall complete continuing professional education activities of at least ten (10) clock hours each license period, July 1 through June 30.
